headline: Teas, Oils, Coffee & Superfoods from the Tropics
subheadline: Where tradition meets technology. Ethically sourced oils, teas, coffee and superfoods from Africa, powered by transparent digital supply chains.
tagline: Nature remembers, and so do we.
teaCtaSub: Whole-leaf character. Honest aroma. Taste of place.
teaEnjoyTitle: Enjoy a cup of tea with your loved ones
teaEnjoyBody: In a world that moves too fast, let the kettle slow everything down. Our tropical black, green, fruit and herbal blends arrive as loose leaves, ready for you to fill into your own teabags. Brew it soft, brew it strong, craft your cup, your way. A warm moment shared becomes a ritual remembered.
oilsCtaSub: Cold-pressed goodness for scalp, skin, and kitchen.
oilsCareTitle: Nourish scalp & skin with 100% natural oils
oilsCareBody: From shea and coconut to castor and beyond our cold-pressed oils are crafted to soothe the scalp, seal in moisture and let your natural glow rise to the surface. Honest texture. Quiet shine. Care you can feel.
coffeeCtaSub: Single-origin lots from storied African regions, bright, floral, and vibrant.
coffeeStoryTitle: Natural coffees from Africa’s legendary terroirs
coffeeStoryBody: From the floral heights of Ethiopia to Kenya’s blackcurrant zing and Tanzania’s cocoa-sweet peaberries, our coffees honor origin. Carefully sourced and roasted to reveal native character: jasmine and citrus, sun-ripened berry, velvety chocolate. Brew with intention; taste the landscape.
moringaCtaSub: Natural superfoods from Africa and the Pacific: clean energy, daily balance.
superfoodsTitle: Natural superfoods from Africa & the Pacific
superfoodsBody: Moringa leaf powder and Baobab fruit powder bring time-honored nutrition to modern routines. Stir into water, smoothies, oats, or tea for a gentle lift, no additives, just whole-plant goodness.
moringaDesc: naturally rich in vitamin A, vitamin E, calcium, iron, and plant antioxidants.
baobabDesc: high in vitamin C with prebiotic fiber to support gut health and immunity.
moringaNutri: Moringa (per 10 g): a natural source of vitamin A & E, iron, calcium, and plant polyphenols.
baobabNutri: Baobab (per 10 g): naturally high vitamin C and prebiotic fiber to support digestion.
howToUse: Use: 1–2 tsp daily in smoothies, yoghurt, porridge, or warm water with lemon.
subscribeText: Get product updates, small-batch releases, and occasional perks.
